biddingAudit._confirmed_note: Confirmed by Martin 2026-08-06 in the bidding-auditor Phase 0 interview. Three decisions were explicit, not defaults — see the _decision notes below. Re-run /bidding-auditor reconfirm if business.md changes materially.
biddingAudit._breakEvenROAS_decision: 1.9 chosen over the 1.6 net-value alternative. business.md §2 derives both and says 'Use 1.9 (conservative) until resolved'. Gap G1 (whether Google receives gross or net conversion values) is still open and moves this threshold by a factor of 1.19 — the single most important unresolved number in the account. Resolving G1 requires Shopify read_orders.
biddingAudit._conversionActionValues_note: 143 EUR = AOV as tracked by Google, derived 2026-08-03 from the purchase-only series (clean value 255,105 / clean conversions 1,788.53). Key matches googleAds.conversionActions exactly. Probably VAT-inclusive — unverified, this is Gap G1.
biddingAudit._parTarget_decision: business.md §3 labels the account 'Cost Control' but sets a non-brand target of clean 2.5 against a 1.9 break-even = 1.32x, which is nearest the growth PAR of 1.2 (implying 2.28). Martin's ruling 2026-08-06: 'Cost Control' describes spend discipline (do not raise budgets), not a demand for 2x return. Using PAR 1.2 keeps the audit aligned to the numeric target Jonas would actually be held to. Efficiency PAR 2.0 would demand clean 3.80 — far above anything signed off.
biddingAudit._tCpaSafetyMargin_note: Left at default. Inert for this account — no campaign runs tCPA (verified 2026-08-03: every campaign is Target ROAS, Maximize Conversion Value, or Target Impression Share).
biddingAudit._measurementLayer_WARNING: MEASUREMENT LAYER IS ACTIVE-BLOCKING. breakEvenROAS 1.9 is a CLEAN (purchase-only) threshold, but the Google Ads API returns metrics.conversions_value on the INFLATED series — purchase_gads_mable plus 'Custom NewCustomerPurchase - Stay Cold Mable', x1.28-1.94 per campaign, x1.50 account-wide. Any engine comparing reported ROAS against 1.9 will overstate profitability by roughly 50%. Martin's ruling 2026-08-06: run the engines, then treat this as an active M-layer block in the constraint cascade, which forbids every target and strategy mutation until conversion goals are fixed. Deflate per campaign with the documented factors before drawing any conclusion. Root cause is 14 of 15 enabled campaigns overriding the account default with custom conversion goal 6446192748 (see account-audit AUD-D24, 2026-08-06). Fix is DON'T-8: humans only.

Martin chose the €32,500 midpoint 2026-08-06 over treating €35k as a spend goal (which would trigger expansion advice contradicting the documented Cost Control mode) or €31k as the target (which would make pacing report 'on track' by definition). Current run rate ~€31k reads as slightly under target but within range.

campaignTargets._note: Priorities derived from business.md §9 campaign priorities and the clean-ROAS positions in §5, approved by Martin 2026-08-06. 'hold' on FOKUSPRODUKTE and PROSPECTING is deliberate: they hold 67% of spend at or below break-even, so they are reduce candidates, never raise candidates. The five zero-impression PMax campaigns are listed at 0 on purpose so the allocation math does not award them a share of the total.

seasonalityProfile.notes: Derived from business.md §14 without prompting. Q4 dominant; BFCM is the single biggest event in account history (Nov 2025: €33,877 spend at clean ROAS 19.38, best month ever). Planned windows from Airtable Drop Base: VIP Sale Weekend 2026-10-02..04; Black Week Special Drops 2026-11-23..30 (PROPOSED BY JONAS, NOT CONFIRMED); 3For2 Hoodies 2026-12-02..17. Treat these months as demand highlights, not as approved promo budget.

searchTermAnalysis._biddingStrategy_note: Changed from 'cpa' to 'roas' 2026-08-03. Every campaign in this account runs Target ROAS, Maximize Conversion Value, or Target Impression Share. There is no tCPA campaign, so CPA-based efficiency judgements were meaningless.
searchTermAnalysis._protectedTerms_note: Hard rule: no term matching 'stay ?cold' is ever proposed as a negative, in any campaign or list (source: search-terms-rules.md rule 1). Brand+product queries route to brand campaigns, they are never negated outright.
searchTermAnalysis._sharedNegativeLists_note: VERIFIED 2026-08-03: the account contains exactly TWO shared negative sets. 'EX I ALL' (78 keywords, id 9606244993, applied broadly across search/shopping/video) and 'EXCLUSIONS FOR BRAND' (3,135 keywords, id 11415316346, applied to all five brand campaigns AND to EX I SHOPPING I FOKUSPRODUKTE). The previous config named three lists that do not exist — writes would have failed silently. The two n-gram lists are set to null on purpose so a run fails loudly instead of writing into the wrong list; Jonas must create them before n-gram push is enabled (gap G20).
searchTermAnalysis._targets_note: Cached 2026-08-06 by search-term-auditor Phase 0.1 from business.md §3. This audit scopes to NON-BRAND (excludeBrandedCampaigns=true), so the non-brand targets apply, not the account-wide ones. business.md: non-brand clean ROAS floor 1.9 (break-even), target 2.5. Account-wide targets (floor 4.0 / target 6.0) are NOT used here because brand campaigns are out of scope.
searchTermAnalysis._targetCPA_note: Null on purpose. No campaign in this account runs tCPA — every one is Target ROAS, Maximize Conversion Value or Target Impression Share (verified 2026-08-03). The implied break-even CPA would be AOV 143 / break-even ROAS 1.9 = ~EUR75, but the account is not steered on CPA so caching it would invite the wrong comparison.
searchTermAnalysis._targetROAS_INFLATION_WARNING: targetROAS 2.5 is a CLEAN threshold. The API returns the INFLATED conversions_value series. IMPORTANT PER-CAMPAIGN NUANCE established 2026-08-06: the non-brand SEARCH campaign (EX I EN I WW I TOF ...) has inflation factor 1.00 - it is the one campaign using the clean account-default conversion goal (business.md 6, corroborated by account-audit AUD-D24). So for non-brand SEARCH terms, reported == clean and 2.5 is directly comparable. Shopping/PMax terms in scope ARE inflated (FOKUSPRODUKTE 1.81, NEAR INDEX 1.28, PMax PROSPECTING 1.88) and must be deflated before judgement.
searchTermAnalysis._brandTerms_note: Written 2026-08-06. Core variants plus typos that remain unmistakably the brand (swapped/doubled/dropped letters, spacing). Deliberately EXCLUDED generic strings that would misclassify via substring matching - e.g. no bare cold, no apparel. Kept stay cold despite being two dictionary words because it IS the brand name and business.md protectedTerms.neverExclude already treats it as such; the ST-D25 brand-share figure should be read with that substring risk in mind.
